verdict.rationale: Reducto is a document-processing API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. Its docs describe one at docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server: once installed, agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, or any MCP client can classify, parse, extract, split, and edit documents without custom integration code, and a probe confirms the page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
